title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 05, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.1 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 06:12 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 326 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic electrons are elevated around Earth! 🛰⚡🌎

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
